author: The_Solo_Player
body:
I'm sorry, but avicore really didn't do anything, except for making avicus even worst. 
Hate, to say this but its the truth and the truth hurts. 

1st. Hackers. There are so many hackers now, flying in plain sight, they don't even try to hide it.

2nd. LAAAAAAGGG... Avicore, didn't fix the lag, in fact it made it worst, I'm lagging even on the lobby

I hate new maps and other issues, but you guys really need to fix this. A lot of commands don't work. Staff are never on. 

To summarize AVICORE SUCKS! Fix it. Till then [removed] (The full IP that shaln't be said)

replies.body:
The lag is just you, there's absolutely no server side lag.
Hackers are indeed a problem, but that's what mods are for!
Staff are on, just because they aren't on at the time YOU are on doesn't mean we don't do our job right! We don't sit in front of the computer 24/7, we have lifes you know.

The issues you listed (most of them) are your own personal problems... Like the fact that you 'hate' the new maps. If you don't like them, go play on the MC Zone servers.
